description: One table's columns (name, type, and any published profile such as null counts, distinct counts or ranges), its immutable version_id, and its capabilities: whether anonymous sampling, keyed querying and Parquet download are enabled. Example: {"table_id": "0f2f6bfa-4a63-4f75-9a0b-1a7d9c5b2e10"}. Read this before writing a query_table call: the column names it lists are the only ones the query grammar accepts.
name: get_table_schema
title: Get a table's schema
